personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, credible, and worker-friendly industrial training tool prioritizing clarity and actionable safety.

spacing.rule: Generous padding and tap targets suitable for industrial workers. Minimum 48pt tap height for primary CTAs.

dont's: No glassmorphism. This is an industrial/utilitarian app for mid-range Android 10+ devices. Rely on solid colors and high-contrast cards to minimize cognitive load.

screens.name: Splash & Language Selection
screens.purpose: Establish brand credibility and let the worker select their primary language.
screens.layout: Deep navy blue (`surfaceInverse`) background. Large safety-helmet logo centered. Bottom 1/3 contains three large, high-contrast language selection cards (English, Hindi, Santali) and an orange sticky primary CTA to 'Continue'.

screens.name: Worker Profile Registration
screens.purpose: Collect worker details for certification tracking.
screens.layout: Navy blue header. Scrollable single-column form with large, touch-friendly text inputs (`surfaceSecondary`). Sticky orange submit CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Showcase training progress, daily streak, and act as a hub for starting modules.

states.empty: Illustration of safety worker with 'Start your first training module' CTA.

screens.layout: Deep navy header band showing Worker Name & Helmet Logo. Body uses light `surface` background. Top white cards (`surfaceSecondary`) show Training Progress (progress bar), Latest Score, and Certificate Status. Below, a vertically stacked list of 'Safety Training Modules' cards (Fire, Gas, etc.) with bilingual labels.

screens.name: AR Camera Training Scenario
screens.purpose: Interactive spatial training utilizing the camera feed with 2D overlays.
screens.layout: Full-screen camera feed. Minimal UI clutter. Top safe area holds a translucent dark bar displaying task progress (Task 1/4). Center screen uses crosshairs or tap-target bounding boxes for AR interaction. Bottom safe area contains a large orange 'Hint/Continue' floating action button.

screens.name: Assessment Engine
screens.purpose: Test the worker's knowledge post-training via MCQs.
screens.layout: Deep navy (`surfaceInverse`) background for the Question Card to maximize focus. Orange 'Q1' badge attached to the top-left of the card. Below the question text, vertically stacked white A/B/C/D option cards (`surfaceSecondary`) acting as massive touch targets.

screens.name: Score Result & Certificate
screens.purpose: Display assessment results and generate a QR-verifiable certificate.
screens.layout: Top section features a large Green (`success`) or Red (`error`) result card. Passed state shows a large circular progress chart. Bottom section displays an Orange 'Get Certificate' button. Tapping reveals the Certificate view with a large QR code and web admin verification link.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE ON COLORS: Navy Blue and Orange are strictly utilized here because the user's brief explicitly required 'deep navy blue header band', 'orange/saffron primary CTA', and 'dark navy question cards'. This aligns with the exception rule allowing these colors when directly mentioned.
Bilingual Support: Ensure component heights are flexible to accommodate Hindi/Santali text strings, which often run longer or taller than English.
Touch Targets: Enforce a minimum 48pt height for all interactable elements (buttons, MCQ option cards, tab items) to support gloved/worker environments.
AR Implementation: Keep the AR 2D overlay extremely clean. Avoid modal popups over the camera view. Rely on an edge-to-edge camera feed with a simple bottom sticky action button for hints/continuing.
Shadows: Keep shadows subtle (Tier 1) on the white cards. The contrast between the light grey background (`surface`) and the white card (`surfaceSecondary`) should do most of the visual separation.
Web Admin Dashboard: Implement this as an integrated web route (/admin) as requested, keeping styling consistent but adapted for broader desktop/tablet viewing.
